facts.text: Florida College provides private higher education with a biblical perspective and maintains a faculty and staff composed entirely of committed Christians.

sources.title: About Us | Florida College
sources.quote: Located in Tampa, Florida College is a private liberal arts school with a goal of providing higher education with a biblical perspective. This unique environment fosters personal spiritual development and prepares students for better service to their Creator and humanity.

sources.title: About Us | Florida College
sources.quote: 100% Christian Faculty and Staff. All faculty and staff members are committed Christians, integrating faith into every aspect of campus life and learning.
